concerns.text: Tasks T001–T006 are marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but they have strict ordering dependencies. T001 creates the core directories that T002‑T006 write files into (e.g., `code/requirements.txt`, `README.md`, `state/project_state.yaml`, `code/seed.py`, `code/data_hygiene.py`). Running them in parallel could cause race conditions or file‑not‑found errors, violating the foundational‑tasks‑first principle. The `[P]` tag should be removed or the tasks reordered so that T001 executes before any of the others.

Task T032 updates `docs/quickstart.md` with a command that invokes `code/main.py`, which is only created later in T033. While this is only documentation, the quickstart should reference an existing script to avoid a broken example. Move T032 after T033 or adjust the quickstart to point to the eventual driver script.
